rubric_source.rubric_caveat: Per-dimension issue-priority table uses 0-49/50-74/75+ ranges although dimensions max25; use explicit 0-25 dimension and 0-100 overall verdict bands; do not invent normalization.

method: 25 x weighted mean of criterion PASS/(PASS+FAIL+UNKNOWN); upper substitutes PASS+UNKNOWN. N/A excluded, weights normalized per dimension. Binary observations are explicitly scoped samples; untested role/state cross-products remain in coverage. No full-product certification.
